corrections: STALE NET-DEBT ANCHOR: The bear's SoP overlay subtracts net debt of EUR 14.48B (a 2026-03-31 scan figure taken AFTER the Blueprint/Dynavax M&A draws), but Sanofi's own FY-2025 results (2026-01-29) report year-end 2025 net debt of EUR 11,008M at ~0.9x net-debt/EBITDA (up from EUR 8,772M at YE-2024). Using the EUR 14.48B figure over-states the equity-value drag by ~EUR 3.5B (~EUR 3/sh) in BOTH the bear (EUR 72-76) and base (EUR 90-92) SoP. The correction cuts modestly in the BULL's favor (less debt = more equity value), so it does not break the bear thesis; rather, the bear's own headline downside is somewhat overstated. The climbing-leverage / aggressive-M&A concern is directionally valid as a forward 'watch' (net debt did rise post-quarter), but it is not a FY-25 reporting fact. Second, minor: the FDA tolebrutinib action date is cited as 2025-12-24 (matching Sanofi's own press release); some trade outlets state the FDA acted 12-23 -- one-day immaterial, the CRL/fired-negative catalyst is confirmed either way.
evidence: Sanofi FY-2025 results press release, 2026-01-29: FY sales EUR 43.6B (+9.9% CER), business EPS EUR 7.83 (+15.0%), Dupixent EUR 15.7B FY / +32.2% in Q4-25; year-end 2025 NET DEBT EUR 11,008M (vs EUR 8,772M YE-2024) at ~0.9x EBITDA; FCF before restructuring/M&A EUR 9,891M, FCF EUR 8,089M -- contradicts the bear's EUR 14.48B net-debt SoP input (sanofi.com/assets/dotcom/pressreleases/2026/2026-01-29-06-30-00-3228191-en.pdf).

Sanofi press release, 2025-12-24: FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for tolebrutinib in non-relapsing secondary progressive MS -- confirms the single dated pipeline binary FIRED NEGATIVE and the re-rate catalyst is spent (sanofi.com/en/media-room/press-releases/2025/2025-12-24-06-00-00-3210238). FDA cited severe drug-induced liver injury (6/~2,700 incl. one transplant+death) and that 'a favorable benefit-risk profile could not be established for any subpopulation' (corroborated by BioSpace/FierceBiotech CRL coverage, Dec-2025).

Sanofi Q1-2026 results, 2026-04-23: Q1 sales +13.6% CER, Dupixent EUR ~4.2B / +30.8%, FY-2026 guidance reaffirmed (high-single-digit CER sales; business EPS at CER slightly faster) -- confirms the CER growth engine continues post-window (sanofi.com/en/media-room/press-releases/2026/2026-04-23-05-30-00-3279572).

Regeneron FY-2025 / Q1-2026 disclosures: Sanofi-Regeneron Dupixent development-balance reimbursement steps down to ~zero by 2027 (balance fell from $2.9B at YE-2022 to ~$0.3B by Q1-2026), ~EUR 500M lower reimbursement vs 2025 -- confirms the 2027 economics step the bear flags is REAL and quantified, a genuine medium-term EPS headwind (investor.regeneron.com FY-2025 results).
